issue_context.title: Improve documentation of supported Python interpreter request formats
issue_context.body:
As discussed in #4397, we support a bunch of formats but the documentation isn't clear / up to date.

See also https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/4401
comments: It'd be nice to improve our `--help` menu and the prose documentation.

review_comments: Intentional that period was removed here?

Yes, I switched it to verbatim mode which I think would retain the period but clap strips them everywhere else. We need to drop the period for consistency. Kind of awkward, https://github.com/clap-rs/clap/issues/3367
This is not correct, moved this fix into https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/5870
